LanguageData.OverHaulers_Compatibility_Desc: Configure how caravan mass capacity is presented on pawn InfoCards when playing alongside other mods. Anatomical and biological calculations are always delivered universally to the game engine.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_PresentationMode_Auto_Toolti: Allows OverHaulers to adopt external caravan stats (such as VEF_MassCarryCapacity), injecting our detailed breakdown directly into their InfoCard. This prevents duplicate stat rows on pawns. If no external stats are detected, it cleanly falls back to the native OverHaulers card.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_PresentationMode_Native_Tool: Forces OverHaulers to always display its own dedicated 'Caravan mass capacity' card on pawns, leaving any third-party mod cards untouched. (Caravan mass capacity calculations remain fully active).
LanguageData.OverHaulers_CilScanIdleDesc: Dynamic bytecode inspection is idle. An active stat card is already configured. Scanning disassembles external Harmony patches on MassUtility.Capacity to discover candidate caravan stats from unlisted or new mods.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_NoCandidateStatsInPatch: - No caravan-related stats detected in this patch.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_NoExternalPatchesDiscovered: No external mod patches detected on MassUtility.Capacity.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_CilFactors_Header: Neutralize capacity factors on this stat:
LanguageData.OverHaulers_CilFactors_None: No active capacity factors detected on this stat.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_CilAdditiveBonus_Label: Treat stat as additive bonus only (preserve vanilla base capacity)
LanguageData.OverHaulers_CilAdditiveBonus_Tooltip: Enable this if the discovered mod's stat starts at 0 and adds a bonus (e.g. backpacks) onto vanilla MassUtility.Capacity rather than replacing the pawn's full caravan capacity. Prevents negative wound offsets from clamping to 0.01 kg inside the stat itself.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Unified_Display: 1 single card: '{0}' under the '{1}' section (pawn 'i' ➔ Stats tab); Over Haulers' native card is hidden.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Unified_Gear: External modifiers (backpacks, gear, traits) and Over Haulers biological ratings are merged cleanly into this card.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Unified_Confirm: Inspect '{0}' on any colonist to view the combined Over Haulers anatomical breakdown.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Standalone_Display: 1 single card: '{0}' under the '{1}' section (pawn 'i' ➔ Stats tab).
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Standalone_Gear: No external stat card is adopted; Over Haulers evaluates biological offsets on its standalone card.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Standalone_Confirm: Inspect '{0}' on any colonist to view biological ratings, bionics, and injury breakdowns.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_SideBySide_Display: Multiple cards: '{0}' under the '{1}' section alongside external mod stat(s) (pawn 'i' ➔ Stats tab).
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_SideBySide_Gear: All active stats remain visible on pawns. Caravan capacity and external gear bonuses continue to calculate without loss.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_SideBySide_Confirm: If you prefer a single clean entry, select 'Automatic Stat Adoption (Recommended)' above or choose a matching profile below.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_SideBySide_ConfirmCil: If you prefer a single clean entry, select a discovered candidate stat below.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Cil_Display: 1 single card: breakdown attached to '{0}' under the '{1}' section (pawn 'i' ➔ Stats tab); Over Haulers' native card is hidden.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Cil_Gear: Caravan InfoCard explanation is injected directly into this external stat.
LanguageData.OverHaulers_Verify_Cil_Confirm: Inspect '{0}' on a colonist. If no Over Haulers breakdown appears or numbers do not update, select another candidate or revert to 'Automatic Stat Adoption (Recommended)'.
